summary: This Form 6-K filed by Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz, a foreign private issuer, announces the publication of interim condensed consolidated financial information for the three months ended March 31, 2026, and incorporates it by reference into an existing S-8 registration statement. It contains no corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or management change. The filing is a routine periodic report of quarterly financial results, not a special situation. The forward-looking cautionary language is standard boilerplate.
